name: Light the Way
source:
“Welcome to Lion's Pride. You've come here to apply as one of our servers, is that correct?"...

It's your first day as a server at the cabaret, and you've already been asked out by five charming young men!! Suave, energetic, affectionate, gentle, or carefree… which do you prefer?

[i]Light the Way[/i] is a fanmade visual novel featuring the five members of Luxiem, where your choices could make or break your relationship with your favourite Luxiem boy.

And trust me, you wouldn't like to go down the wrong path~

So, choose wisely! Who will be the one by your side to light your way as you explore a brand new chapter in life?

[From [url=https://simporiem-studios.itch.io/light-the-way]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“欢迎来到狮子之傲。你来这里是为了申请成为我们的服务器之一，对吗？”…

这是你在歌舞表演当服务员的第一天，五个迷人的年轻人已经约你出去了！文雅、活力、深情、温柔、无忧无虑……你更喜欢哪一个？

[i]Light the Way[/i] 是一部粉丝制作的视觉小说，以Luxiem的五名成员为主角，你的选择可能会决定你与你最喜欢的Luxiem男孩的关系的成败。

相信我，你不会想走上错误的路的~

所以，明智地选择！当你探索人生的全新篇章时，谁会在你身边照亮你的道路？

[来自[url=https://simporiem-studios.itch.io/light-the-way]Itch.io[/url]]
